FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_Fibonacci_Calculator
VAR_INPUT
    N : DINT := 5; // Input value for the Fibonacci sequence
END_VAR

VAR_OUTPUT
    O : DINT := 1; // Output value for the N-th Fibonacci number
END_VAR

VAR
    F1 : DINT := 1; // First Fibonacci number
    F2 : DINT := 1; // Second Fibonacci number
    CNT : DINT := 2; // Counter for the loop
END_VAR

// Main logic to calculate Fibonacci number
IF N <= 0 THEN
    O := 0; // Return 0 for non-positive input
ELSIF N = 1 OR N = 2 THEN
    O := 1; // Return 1 for the first two Fibonacci numbers
ELSE
    // Calculate Fibonacci sequence iteratively
    WHILE CNT <= N DO
        // Calculate the next Fibonacci number
        F1 := F2;
        F2 := F1 + F2;

        // Check for saturation
        IF F2 > 32767 THEN
            F2 := 32767; // Saturate to max value
        END_IF;

        CNT := CNT + 1; // Increment counter
    END_WHILE;
    O := F2; // Set output to the N-th Fibonacci number
END_IF;

END_FUNCTION_BLOCK

PROGRAM Main
VAR
    FibonacciCalc : FB_Fibonacci_Calculator; // Instance of the Fibonacci calculator
    NN : DINT := 5; // Default input value
    Result : DINT; // Variable to hold the result
END_VAR

// Initialize and calculate Fibonacci number
FibonacciCalc(N := NN); // Call the function block with NN
Result := FibonacciCalc.O; // Get the output from the function block

// Optionally, you can add code here to handle the Result as needed
END_PROGRAM
